content: लोपः [लुप्-भावे घञ्] .²1 Taking away, deprivation; robbing, plundering. .²2 Loss, destruction. .²3 Abolition, cancellation, annulment (of customs), disappearance, disuse. .²4 Violation, transgression; धर्मलोपभयात् <ls>R. 1. 76</ls>. .²5 Want, failure, absence; सोऽहमिज्याविशुद्धात्मा प्रजालोपनिमीलितः <ls>R. 1. 68</ls>. .²6 Omission, dropping; तद्वद् धर्मस्य लोपे स्यात् <ls>K. P. 10</ls>. .²7 Elision, dropping (in <ab>gram.</ab>); अदर्शनं लोपः <ls>P. I. 1. 60</ls>. .²8 Being perplexed or confounded. .²9 Breaking, fracture.
